name: esposter
description: Claude Code plugins that live in the Esposter monorepo.

plugins.name: follow-ups
plugins.description: Writes the follow-ups a session leaves unfinished into an Esposter TodoList, and drains them again one change at a time until none is left.

plugins.name: genshin-mods
plugins.description: Six mods, each switched by its own command: five under one band above the prompt (the next steps one press each, the cache and usage with a one-click handoff, recording mode, a goal's task list and a question before editing a file another session just changed, which also refuses a whole-index git command while another session shares the checkout), and the machine watcher. Two guards run in every session without a command: a delegation guard and a disk-scan guard.

plugins.name: genshin-persona
plugins.description: Speaks as the Genshin Impact character whose birthday is nearest to today, and reads each spoken line aloud as the reply is written, in the character's own cloned voice.
